messages:
FinanceOps: Alert: nightly job flagged ~$6.4k in asia-southeast1 GPU spend with no project owner tag. Need attribution and provisional chargeback before EOD. :rotating_light:
cloud-ops: Can run a quick rollup. What's the billing dataset?
FinanceOps: billing_view.gcp_billing_export_v1_77123. Quick SQL I usually run:
```sql
SELECT project_id, SUM(cost) AS cost, SUM(usage_amount) AS gpu_hours
FROM `billing_view.gcp_billing_export_v1_77123.gcp_billing_export_v1_*`
WHERE usage_start_time >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 12 HOUR)
AND sku_description LIKE '%GPU%'
GROUP BY project_id
ORDER BY cost DESC
LIMIT 20;
```
cloud-ops: ran it. Top results: analytics-sandbox $4.9k (260 hrs), infra-temp $900 (45 hrs), misc-playground $500 (28 hrs). analytics-sandbox is 76% of the orphan amount.
FinanceOps: who owns analytics-sandbox? @sara?
sara: Yes, that's our team. We did a one-off dataset scan but had a 24h cap. I'll check CI and any rogue jobs.
dev-team: quick check: a nightly ETL kicked off a heavy gpu transform after re-run of failed shards. I see job id etl-7723 started at 23:30 and didn't honor the retry semaphore. Stopping now.
cloud-ops: instances: asean-gp-2001, asean-gp-2002 each with 8 GPUs. Pod runtimes: 23:31 -> 02:10.
FinanceOps: provisional allocation needed. Can we get an attributable cost for that window?
sara: sliced cost for 23:30-02:15 gives analytics-sandbox = $4,900. I'll take the retro charge and create ledger entry PROV-247890-1 to R&D-temp.
billing-bot: Ticket created BILL-4102 "Provisional allocation: analytics-sandbox asia-southeast1 orphan GPU spend". Assignee: sara. Due: EOD.
cloud-ops: suggest adding a retry-semaphore rule in the job controller and a billing tag enforcement in CI.
dev-team: will add a small PR to respect the semaphore and add cost-center annotation.
FinanceOps: thanks. We'll hold provisional transfer until invoice arrives and reconcile. Closing thread; follow BILL-4102 for updates. :white_check_mark:
